name: blender
title: Blender (3D art made by Python scripts)
applies: A project whose 3D models are made by Python generator scripts that Blender runs without a screen, one script per piece, in the folder named in conventions/blender/settings.sh.

rules.rule: Every generator runs in Blender without an error and writes at least one file.
Every model a generator writes (FBX, glTF, OBJ) loads back into Blender and holds at least one mesh.
No model has more triangles than ART_MAX_TRIANGLES in conventions/blender/settings.sh, when it is set.
Binary files are committed only in the folders the owner names; everywhere else they are refused.
enforced_by: the diff policy of the Maestro service (policy.binary_paths)
the secret scan of the Maestro service

rules.rule: The agent cannot change these rules, the scripts that check them, the skill, or the CI workflows.
enforced_by: the diff policy of the Maestro service (protected paths)

image:
RUN set -eu; \
    apt-get update; \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends xz-utils libgl1 libopengl0 libegl1 libsm6 libice6 libxi6 \
      libxkbcommon0 libxrender1 libxt6 libxfixes3 libxext6 libx11-6 libxxf86vm1; \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; \
    case "$TARGETARCH" in amd64) arch=x64 ;; arm64) arch=arm64 ;; *) echo "Blender has no build for $TARGETARCH" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; \
    base=https://download.blender.org/release/Blender5.0; \
    file="blender-5.0.1-linux-$arch.tar.xz"; \
    cd /tmp; \
    curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -o "$file" "$base/$file"; \
    curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -o blender.sha256 "$base/blender-5.0.1.sha256"; \
    grep " $file\$" blender.sha256 | sha256sum -c -; \
    mkdir -p /opt/blender; \
    tar -xJf "$file" -C /opt/blender --strip-components=1; \
    rm -f "$file" blender.sha256; \
    ln -s /opt/blender/blender /usr/local/bin/blender
image_note: Blender 5.0.1 from blender.org, checked against its published checksum (about 1 GB)
after_apply: Set ART_SOURCE and ART_OUTPUT in conventions/blender/settings.sh to your folders.
Let the agent commit the models: in the settings file, policy.binary_paths: ["<ART_OUTPUT>/**"]. Everywhere else binary files stay refused.
For pictures on the pull request: screenshots.command: sh conventions/blender/previews.sh
